## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Use `Closes #…` only if this PR satisfies every remaining acceptance criterion of the issue; otherwise use `Part of #…` and list what remains. Roadmap ID: LRN-…. The issue must be assigned to the PR author.

## Acceptance criteria

Copy the issue's criteria and mark each met or not met.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Do not list checks that were not run.

## Scope and risks

Identify any permission, content schema, API, migration, or licensing implications, and any shared contract changed.

## Contribution rights

Link the applicable adopted terms, contributor acceptance and third-party provenance, or state that these are pending. A checkbox or this PR alone is not consent to unpublished terms. External contributions remain blocked until the [rights gate](https://github.com/hadden-me/learnoo/blob/develop/docs/CONTRIBUTION_TERMS.md) is satisfied.

## Handoff

- **What changed:**
- **Tests actually run:**
- **Unresolved problems / unverified:**
- **Exact next step:**
